AboutPage.title: About
AboutPage.p1: Hello, I’m Ertuğrulcan. While my primary focus is frontend development, I possess a deep understanding of the entire web stack, allowing me to build robust, end-to-end solutions. I graduated in Computer Programming in 2018 and have since been refining my craft across the full spectrum of software development.
AboutPage.p2: My expertise goes beyond just UI. I am proficient in modern frontend technologies like React, Next.js, React Native, Expo, Shadcn UI, and Tailwind CSS, paired with design tools like Figma, Photoshop, and After Effects to create exceptional user experiences.
AboutPage.p3: On the backend and infrastructure side, I work with Node.js, WebSocket, JWT, Auth.js, and databases such as PostgreSQL and MS SQL. I manage deployments using Docker, Docker Compose, Coolify, and reverse proxies like Traefik, Caddy, and Nginx. I also handle server administration with Ubuntu/Linux bash and SSH, and secure applications using Cloudflare WAF and DNS.
AboutPage.p4: I ensure quality through E2E testing with Playwright and automate workflows using GitHub Actions. Currently, I am working at Ayasofyazılım, continuing to expand my knowledge and contribute to open-source projects.

mechanics.title: Core Mechanics
mechanics.grid: The game is played on a 6x6 grid. Each player controls an element (Fire, Water, Earth, Air).
mechanics.capture: Every turn, you capture a tile by solving a question based on the room's category.
mechanics.jump: If your selected tile "jumps" over an enemy tile, you attempt to capture both the empty tile and the enemy's tile.
mechanics.note: Note: Capturing enemy tiles makes the question harder!

scoring.title: Scoring & Winning
scoring.summary: Points are used to buy powerful items if "Item Mode" is enabled. The player with the most tiles/points at the end wins!

items.title: Power-Ups & Items
items.shield: Apply to your own tiles to protect them from being swapped or captured by enemies.
items.trap: Place on empty tiles. Invisible to enemies! If they select it, their points are reduced by 50.
items.strike: Attack an enemy tile directly to neutralize their control.
items.phoenix: Grants a second chance if you answer incorrectly.
